evidence_set: The review states that it abstracted data from prospective controlled trials with methodologically sound end points corresponding to the DSM-IV definitions, and lists withdrawal delirium as defined in DSM-IV among its outcomes; it does not say how the definitions used in its pooled trials (dated 1961 to 1986 in Tables 2 to 4, all before DSM-IV) were judged to correspond. The guideline does not address patients seen after a withdrawal seizure or with established withdrawal delirium (delirium tremens), or the choice of inpatient or outpatient setting.
